title: Fully funded
subtitle: US PhD roadmap
description: A live roadmap through the complete US PhD application — taught by a researcher who secured a fully funded position at Northeastern University. Not a broadcast: a private small-group mentorship with live Q&A.
mentorHeading: Learn from someone who has already done it.
mentorBio: Abdullah made the journey from Bangladesh to a fully funded PhD at Northeastern University — navigating research alignment, cold outreach, and funding conversations without a guide. Now he distills everything he learned into a single, candid roadmap session.
outcomesHeading: After 100 minutes, you will have a clearer plan
outcomesIntro: Eight outcomes — each a real decision in a funded US PhD application, distilled from a successful one.

outcomes.title: Approach the process strategically
outcomes.description: A framework, not a checklist — sequence every move from shortlist to submit.

outcomes.title: What makes a strong funded applicant
outcomes.description: The signals committees weigh beyond GPA: research, publications, projects, fit.

outcomes.title: Find suitable universities & professors
outcomes.description: Shortlist by research group and funding track, not just rankings.

outcomes.title: Communicate with professors effectively
outcomes.description: Cold emails that get replies — framing, attachments, and follow-up.

outcomes.title: Structure a PhD-focused CV
outcomes.description: Present research, projects, and publications the way faculty read them.

outcomes.title: Write a stronger SOP
outcomes.description: Connect background, research interest, and future goals into one narrative.

outcomes.title: Improve your application before submission
outcomes.description: The upgrades that move a borderline profile to competitive.

outcomes.title: Your next steps
outcomes.description: Leave with the next three moves to make in your PhD journey this week.

testimonials.quote: It was a very helpful session. Many of my confusions are clear now, and my AbroadMate gave me proper direction for my next steps. They carefully analyzed my background and goals and provided detailed feedback along with some useful website links. I really appreciated the guidance and would like to book another session in the near future.

I enjoy receiving personalized guidance based on my academic background and career goals. My AbroadMate provides clear advice on scholarships, university selection, and application strategies, and answers my questions patiently — which makes the whole process much easier and more motivating.

I really appreciated how humble and patient my AbroadMate was. An exceptional listener who carefully heard out all my problems and provided clear, practical solutions. They gave me plenty of time without any rush, which made the session incredibly helpful and reassuring.
